description: This file defines a configuration class for the Starboard Linux Cobalt environment, including test filters and environment variables.

classes.name: CobaltLinuxConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for Starboard Linux Cobalt, extending cobalt_configuration.CobaltConfiguration, providing test filters and environment variables.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configuration with platform, application name, and directory.

methods.name: GetTestFilters
methods.description: Returns a list of test filters, extending base filters with additional project-specific filters.

methods.name: GetWebPlatformTestFilters
methods.description: Returns a list of web platform test filters, including timing-sensitive tests.

methods.name: GetTestEnvVariables
methods.description: Provides environment variables for different test suites, mainly configuring ASAN options.
